name: solyx-webui
description: Client chat UI for Solyx Energy: chat with the WordPress-editing agent, watch drafts update live. Never touches production; never publishes.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/server && npm run build --workspace packages/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/server && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/web && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/stub
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/server && npm run test --workspace packages/web
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && systemctl --user restart solyx-webui && sleep 3 && systemctl --user is-active solyx-webui
